registration.candidate: At most one correction per battle, for the candidate team only. At the first root where both existing full R2 samples kill its ranged actor and enemy XP damage is less than 0.25 allied XP loss, choose an already fully scored ranged alternative surviving both samples with positive enemy damage and allied loss no greater. Highest full mean, then immediate net XP, then catalog index. Unlike the closed conservative rule, no full-forecast floor. Spend the single budget only on an actual correction. All later turns use the default.
registration.development: The separate closed conservative 432-battle screen gained zero. Fourteen registered one-shot reused-bank branches recovered one loss and two draws, with no worse results. All 14 automatic one-budget policy traces reproduce those branches exactly. This is functional admission, not qualification.
registration.population: First two naturally ranged-vs-ranged native ranked drafts per map/own doctrine/opponent doctrine/pick order; all 3 maps and all 5/6/7-point pairs, both board seats, two combat futures.
registration.primary: Equal-weight whole-family mean candidate-minus-default match score. Scores 0 loss, 0.5 draw, 1 win. No interim outcome inspection.
registration.confidence: 20000 whole-family xorshift32 resamples, seed17112026; sorted indices500 and19500. Independent integer half-point verification.
registration.cold: Before fresh combat, 3 fixed admitted cases indices0/6/13 reproduce on hft. After collection, fresh cases family indices0/36/72, seat0/future0, both arms reproduce in new local processes.
registration.quality: Owned common identity for both runtime and server, exact native paid setup/placement, equal arm openings, zero rejected engine actions/neural errors, health ledger valid, whole bank complete. No source change, outcome-based subset, reallocation, automatic retry or extension.
registration.promotion: No automatic default change. A positive fresh screen still needs separately registered independent confirmation and quiet complete-decision/full-fight runtime within +10%.

analyze.py.source:
from pathlib import Path
import collections, gzip, hashlib, json, statistics

P = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
def read(name):
    b = (P / name).read_bytes()
    return json.loads(gzip.decompress(b) if name.endswith('.gz') else b)
def stable(value): return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'))
def bootstrap(values):
    state = 17112026
    def next_int():
        nonlocal state
        state ^= (state << 13) & 0xffffffff; state ^= state >> 17; state ^= (state << 5) & 0xffffffff; state &= 0xffffffff
        return state
    means = sorted(sum(values[next_int() % len(values)] for _ in values) / len(values) * 100 for _ in range(20000))
    return [means[500], means[19500]]

reg = read('registration.json'); reg_hash = hashlib.sha256((P / 'registration.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
families = []; counters = collections.Counter(); sources = {}; timings = collections.defaultdict(list)
for task in read('cases.json'):
    deltas = []; changes = 0; danger = 0; scores = collections.defaultdict(float)
    for seat in [0, 1]:
        for future in [0, 1]:
            case = f'{task["id"]}-s{seat}-f{future}'
            paths = {m:f'pilot/{case}-{m}.json.gz' for m in ['observe', 'candidate']}
            rows = {m:read(path) for m,path in paths.items()}
            assert read(f'pilot/complete-{case}.json')['qualityPassed']
            for mode,row in rows.items():
                assert row['qualityPassed'] and row['receipt']['qualityPassed']
                assert row['registrationSha256'] == reg_hash
                assert row['score'] in [0, 0.5, 1]
                assert row['result']['winner'] in ['green', 'red', 'draw']
                expected = 0.5 if row['result']['winner'] == 'draw' else int(row['result']['winner'] == ('green' if row['candidateTeam'] == 2 else 'red'))
                assert row['score'] == expected
                counters[f'{mode}_battles'] += 1
                counters[f'{mode}_wins' if row['score']==1 else f'{mode}_draws' if row['score']==0.5 else f'{mode}_losses'] += 1
                counters[f'{mode}_roots'] += len(row['observations'])
                counters[f'{mode}_danger_roots'] += sum(o['danger'] for o in row['observations'])
                counters[f'{mode}_overrides'] += sum(o['changed'] for o in row['observations'])
                timings[mode].append(row['elapsedMs'])
                sources[paths[mode]] = hashlib.sha256((P / paths[mode]).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                scores[mode] += row['score']
            assert stable(rows['observe']['opening']) == stable(rows['candidate']['opening'])
            diff = rows['candidate']['score'] - rows['observe']['score']; deltas.append(diff)
            counters['better_cases' if diff > 0 else 'worse_cases' if diff < 0 else 'tied_cases'] += 1
            changed = stable(rows['candidate']['turns']) != stable(rows['observe']['turns'])
            changes += changed
            if changed: counters['changed_trajectories'] += 1
            else:
                for field in ['result','events','health']: assert stable(rows['candidate'][field]) == stable(rows['observe'][field])
            danger += sum(o['danger'] for o in rows['observe']['observations'])
    families.append({'id':task['id'],'map':task['map'],'d1':task['d1'],'d2':task['d2'],'pickOrder':task['pickOrder'],'delta':statistics.mean(deltas),'caseDeltas':deltas,'changedCases':changes,'baselineDangerRoots':danger,'scores':dict(scores)})
assert len(families) == 108 and counters['observe_battles'] == counters['candidate_battles'] == 432
values=[f['delta'] for f in families]; mean=statistics.mean(values)*100; interval=bootstrap(values)
groups={}
for axis in ['map','d1','d2','pickOrder']:
    groups[axis]={str(k):{'families':len([f for f in families if f[axis]==k]),'meanPp':statistics.mean(f['delta'] for f in families if f[axis]==k)*100} for k in sorted({f[axis] for f in families})}
changed_families=sum(f['changedCases'] > 0 for f in families)
gates={'meanAtLeastHalfPoint':mean>=0.5,'lower95StrictlyPositive':interval[0]>0,'atLeastTwelveChangedFamilies':changed_families>=12,'noMapOrDoctrineBelowMinusOnePoint':all(g['meanPp']>=-1 for axis in ['map','d1','d2'] for g in groups[axis].values())}
summary={'registrationSha256':reg_hash,'complete':True,'battles':864,'families':108,'meanScoreGainPp':mean,'familyBootstrap95Pp':interval,'counters':dict(counters),'changedFamilies':changed_families,'subgroups':groups,'gates':gates,'screenPassed':all(gates.values()),'promotionAuthorized':False,'wallTimeIsSharedLoadDescriptiveOnly':True,'medianBattleMs':{k:statistics.median(v) for k,v in timings.items()},'familyResults':families}
with(P/'analysis.json').open('x')as f:json.dump(summary,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
with(P/'result-receipts.json').open('x')as f:json.dump(sources,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in summary.items() if k not in ['familyResults','subgroups']}))

selection.rule: First two natural drafts with a ranged unit on both teams per map/doctrine pair/pick order
